find.match_belief: My main passion for music is sharing catharsis and resonating with the audience through live shows. Besides, I also enjoy blending or exploring different genres and sounds in my music.

profile.belief: Storytelling has always been part of my life. Growing up, my family shared stories constantly, and watching films together every weekend became a tradition. That naturally led me to directing because I didn’t just want to experience stories—I wanted to create them. I enjoy the challenge of turning ideas into films and collaborating with others to bring those stories to life.
profile.working_on: My goal is to become a writer, director, and producer who creates stories that have a lasting social and cultural impact. Beyond making films, I want to create work that brings people together, encourages empathy, and gives different voices and experiences a place to be seen and heard.
